title: INGCO DM200 CAT III 600V Industrial AC/DC Digital Multimeter

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Ingco DM200 CAT III 600V Industrial AC/DC Digital Multimeter is a dependable and safety-focused testing instrument built for electricians, technicians, and industrial professionals. With its CAT III 600V safety rating, this multimeter ensures secure operation when working with distribution panels, industrial equipment, and electrical systems.


This digital multimeter supports precise measurement of AC voltage, DC voltage, current, and resistance, making it suitable for a wide range of electrical diagnostics and troubleshooting tasks. The clear LCD display provides easy-to-read results, while the rugged body design ensures durability in tough working environments.


The Ingco DM200 is an excellent choice for workshops, factories, electrical maintenance, and professional field use where accuracy, safety, and reliability are essential.


Key Features


  • CAT III 600V safety-rated digital multimeter
  • Accurate AC and DC voltage measurement
  • Reliable current and resistance testing
  • Industrial-grade durable construction
  • Easy-to-read digital LCD display
  • Suitable for professional electrical applications
